result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of the relevant data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion certification. It leaves the existing payment and survival terms unchanged and adds only the needed exit obligations. Drafting is professional, though Section 4.3 should be placed in numerical order and ideally expressly included in the survival provision to avoid any question about post-termination enforceability.
